note: Manager career ending copy. Titles are decided in the order of pickTitle in js/state/career.js. Placeholders: {team} team name, {seasons} number of seasons, {trophies} number of trophies, {captain} most appearances, {scorer} all-time top scorer, {best} best season

double.label: Master of the Double
double.summary: Lifted the league title and a continental trophy in the same season.
board: A new chapter has been written in {team}'s history. Precious few managers have conquered both the league and Europe in the same year.
The board has decided to record the {best} season as the greatest year in the club's history. You were at the heart of it.
We handed you a team. What you gave us back was a legend.
A motion to build a new trophy cabinet was passed unanimously.
Every penny invested across your {seasons}-season tenure was repaid by that single campaign. Thank you.
fans: I'll never forget the parade that summer. The whole city was painted in {team} colours.
The first season I took my kid to was the Double season. I'll be bragging about it for the rest of my life.
Cried the day we won the league, then cried again on cup final day. All I remember from that season is tears.
There's a petition going round to paint the gaffer's face on a mural outside the ground.
The {team} of our generation — that's the gaffer's team.
captain: I wore the armband and lifted two trophies. Thanks to the boss, a dream became reality.
That season the dressing room forgot how to lose. The boss made it that way.
I reckon it was the boss's notebook — studying every opponent, every week — that won us that season.
As a player, there'll never be a season better than that one. Thanks, boss.
First into the training ground, last to leave. We had no choice but to follow.

europe.label: Conqueror of Europe
europe.summary: Reached the summit of the Champions League.
board: A manager who brought home the European Cup will forever be part of this club.
You raised the name of {team} higher than ever on Europe's greatest stage.
The footage from that final will hang in the first room of the club museum.
The board is considering naming the training ground in your honour.
You were the only one who believed this club could stand on top of Europe.
fans: That night we were the happiest fans in Europe.
My mate who went to the final still keeps the ticket in his wallet.
The Champions League anthem feels like our song now.
The gaffer gave us the moment my grandad waited his whole life to see.
We'll be singing the gaffer's name on every European night.
captain: As a kid I only ever saw that trophy on TV. Now I've lifted it. I still can't believe it.
I'll remember what the boss said the night before the final for the rest of my life: 'We've already proved we deserve to be here.'
Even against Europe's giants, the boss was never once intimidated. It rubbed off on all of us.
My proudest moment as captain was hugging the boss that night.
I take back every moan about the long tactics meetings. There was a reason for all of it.

dynasty.label: The Dynasty Builder
dynasty.summary: Won the league several times and defined an era.
board: One title can be luck, but several titles are a system. You built that system.
Throughout your {seasons}-season reign, {team} set the standard for the whole league.
Our rivals have started copying us. That is the proof of a dynasty.
The board hopes the methods you leave behind will become part of the club's identity.
Making winning the league feel normal — that is your greatest achievement.
fans: Kids these days think winning the league is just what {team} do.
An era where there was something to celebrate on the last day of every season. I'll miss it.
When the other teams' fans started hating us, that's when we knew we were on top.
I've kept every shirt from the gaffer's era.
I ran out of fingers counting the trophies.
captain: The more winners' medals we piled up, the hungrier the boss looked. That was the secret.
Every season he gave us a new target. Last year's title was last year's news.
My time at this club is my whole career.
I wore the armband, but the real captain was the boss.
I worried we'd get bored of winning. That day never came.

miracle.label: The Miracle Worker
miracle.summary: Lifted a trophy with a team nobody expected anything from.
board: We dug out the pre-season predictions again. Our name was a long way down the list.
A manager who achieved far more than the resources allowed. That is how the board will remember you.
That season cannot be explained by the budget sheet. Perhaps only you can explain it.
They say there are no miracles in football. We saw one with our own eyes.
Every time the press wrote 'shock', we read it as 'the result of preparation'.
fans: Do you know what odds the bookies gave us for the title? Still makes me laugh.
When nobody believed, the gaffer did. And then he made us believe too.
Someone needs to make a film about the {best} season. I'm serious.
The day we lifted the trophy, I was hugging total strangers outside the ground and crying.
Thanks for proving that a club like ours can win it too.
captain: Everyone had us down for relegation. The boss pinned those articles up in the dressing room.
Every time we faced players who cost more than us, the boss pointed out exactly where they were weak.
I know we achieved more than our ability should have allowed. That's why I'm even prouder.
When he said in the tactics meeting 'this is how we win today', that's exactly how we won.
Not one player in this squad will ever forget this season.

champion.label: The Serial Winner
champion.summary: Leaves with silverware in the cabinet.
board: Thank you for delivering exactly what we asked of you.
Trophies are remembered as numbers, but the way they were won will live on in the club's culture.
Trophies won: {trophies}. No small figure in this club's history.
We learned what it means to have a manager who knows how to win.
The bar for the next manager has been set far too high. That is your fault.
fans: My season ticket from the title-winning year is in a frame.
The moment the trophy went up is my phone wallpaper.
That season, every week, we went to the ground believing we'd win.
They still sing the song with the gaffer's name in it.
The manager who showed us a title. That's enough for me.
captain: I remember what the boss said the day we got our winners' medals: 'This is only the beginning.'
Playing under someone who knows how to win was a special experience.
Every time things got tough, the boss came up with the answer. All we did was carry it out.
The moment I lifted the trophy, the first person I looked for was the boss.
Leading this team to a title as captain is something I'll be proud of for life.

climber.label: The Promotion Man
climber.summary: Took the team up to a bigger stage.
board: Promotion changes a club's future. You changed ours.
We will see the name of {team} on a bigger stage once again.
The extra revenue from promotion will be invested in the next generation.
You gave direction to a club that had been bouncing between divisions.
Going up is remarkable, but building a team capable of going up is even more so.
fans: I was one of the lot who ran onto the pitch the day promotion was sealed. Sorry about that.
I've been looking at next season's away fixtures and I'm too excited to sleep.
I remember the hard years in the lower league, so this means even more.
I've watched the promotion season highlights a hundred times already.
Thanks, gaffer, for taking us back to the big stage.
captain: Even under all the pressure of a promotion race, the boss stayed calm.
When the final whistle went in the last game, it was the first time I'd seen the boss properly laugh.
We used to play in tiny grounds. Now we're stepping onto the big stage.
He says the players won promotion, but it was the boss who drew up the plan.
The boss was the first person to say this team could go up again.

rebuilder.label: Architect of the Rebuild
rebuilder.summary: Rebuilt a team that had fallen apart.
board: We put the league table from your first season next to the one from your last. It looked like a different club.
A team rebuilt from the foundations up does not collapse easily. Thank you.
The squad you leave behind will be an asset for years to come.
Thank you for staying with us through a period that demanded patience.
We have never had a manager who suited the word 'rebuild' so well.
fans: Everyone had their doubts at first. Now everyone's gutted to see him go.
You could see the team getting better every year. That was the best part.
Watching the players the gaffer brought through was a real joy.
I'm proud to support a team that climbed back up from rock bottom.
These days I actually look forward to watching us play. That wasn't always the case.
captain: When he arrived, the mood in the dressing room was the worst it could be. The boss changed it bit by bit.
A team that was used to losing got used to winning.
The boss looked at the process before the results. The results followed.
I'm proud to have been at the centre of that change as captain.
The next manager is inheriting a good team. That's down to the boss.

overachiever.label: The Overachiever
overachiever.summary: Finished higher than predicted, season after season.
board: On average, the team finished {over} places above its pre-season prediction. The numbers speak for themselves.
Consistently getting more out of the squad than its resources suggest — that is the definition of a good manager.
Whenever your name came up in board meetings, the words 'beyond expectations' were never far behind.
Measured against budget, you were the best manager in the league.
Thanks to you, this club now sets its sights higher.
fans: I was always nervous before the season, and always smiling at the end of it.
Every year he proved the pundits wrong.
You've no idea how good it felt finishing above clubs with far more money than us.
The gaffer was someone who pushed players beyond their limits.
The {best} season — you remember how happy we were back then, don't you?
captain: The boss rated us higher than we rated ourselves.
He made us believe there was a way to beat anyone.
The opposition analysis before every match was spot on. That was the difference.
A team that always finished above its reputation. That was the boss's team.
I'm certain I became a better player under the boss.

firefighter.label: The Firefighter
firefighter.summary: Kept a team tipped for relegation in the division.
board: When everyone feared relegation, you kept the team up. That is worth more than any sum of money.
Survival is not glamorous, but it is the club's very existence.
Thank you for having the courage to take on a difficult job.
Not once in your {seasons}-season spell did the team fall apart. That is your achievement.
The next manager will start in the league that you preserved.
fans: I was biting my nails right up to the final day, but we survived in the end, didn't we?
The roar the day survival was confirmed was louder than most title celebrations.
He's the manager who stood by us through the hardest times.
I saved all the articles predicting we'd go down and binned the lot at the end of the season.
Thanks to the gaffer, I'm cheering us on in the same league again this season.
captain: A relegation scrap is a battle of mentality. The boss kept our heads right.
Even when we lost, the boss started talking about the plan for the next game. That's how we kept going.
It wasn't pretty, but we played for each other.
As captain, I'm grateful to the boss for not letting this team crumble.
We learned how to survive. That's one of the hardest things in football.

fallen.label: The Hard Road
board: The outcome was disappointing, but we know you fought to the very end.
Relegation is the responsibility of everyone at the club. You need not carry it alone.
Thank you for not walking away from the team in difficult times.
We believe this experience will make the club stronger.
When we one day return, your time here will be remembered too.
fans: The day we went down was really hard. But I don't blame the gaffer.
There were good days too, weren't there? Like the {best} season.
Whatever league we're in, we're {team} fans.
We'll go back up. What the gaffer left behind will help with that.
I saw that he never gave up. That's enough for me.
captain: We should have done more to help the boss.
Results aren't everything — that's something I learned at this club.
Even in the hard seasons, the boss never blamed us.
As captain, I'll never forget the boss who went through that pain with us.
If we ever meet again, I hope we'll be smiling together next time.

underachiever.label: Unfinished Business
underachiever.summary: Did not get the results the squad was capable of.
board: It is true that we expected more. Nevertheless, thank you for your efforts.
The numbers are unforgiving, but the effort you put in lies in the parts the records do not show.
We hope this experience serves you well in the next stage of your career.
We will reflect together on the gap between expectations and results.
Thank you for the time you devoted to this club.
fans: Honestly, I think that squad could have done better.
Still, a few of the games in the {best} season were brilliant.
Being this disappointed just shows how high our hopes were.
I hope the next manager takes this squad further.
Either way, he was our manager. Thanks for everything.
captain: We didn't live up to what the boss expected of us. A lot of that is on the players.
There were plenty of games where luck just wasn't with us.
The boss believed in us to the end. I'm sorry we couldn't repay that with results.
As captain, I feel I should have led better.
Here's hoping for better results next time, boss.

steady.label: Mr Consistent
steady.summary: Held the expected position without wavering.
board: A team that does not wobble. That is the greatest asset you leave behind.
Predictability is a great blessing when running a football club.
Thank you for meeting the agreed objective every single season.
Getting through your {seasons}-season tenure without major highs and lows is harder than it looks.
We will prepare for the next leap forward on the stable foundations you built.
fans: In the gaffer's time I could watch matches with peace of mind.
No famous titles, but no embarrassing seasons either.
He's the manager who consistently served up proper {team} football.
A team that always holds its ground — that's not easy, is it?
I think he laid the foundations for the next step.
captain: The boss always treated us by the same standards. That's why we could trust him.
We were a team that never got carried away and never fell apart.
Every week we knew exactly what we had to do. That was the secret to our consistency.
As captain, I'm proud of how steady this team was.
Quietly strong. That's the team the boss built.

journeyman.label: The Quiet Commander
journeyman.summary: Saw the seasons through alongside the team.
board: Thank you for leading the team throughout your {seasons}-season spell.
We believe you leave behind more than the records show.
Your time with us is a valued page in the club's history.
Even in difficult circumstances, you saw your job through to the end.
We wish you the very best of luck on your next journey.
fans: There were good days and hard days. It was good having him with us.
{scorer}'s goals will live long in the memory.
I'll never forget some of the games from the gaffer's time.
Thanks for everything you did for our club.
If I see you at the ground next time, you'll get a round of applause from me.
captain: I'm grateful for the time I spent playing under the boss.
He always stood up for the players.
Whatever the results, the boss brought the team together as one.
As captain, I learned a great deal from the boss.
Come back any time, boss. The door's always open.
